column1: # The uses of busybox and of shells that the build rules still make, one row per file and rule: file<TAB>rule<TAB>max. No line numbers.
# ci/no_shell_check.zig refuses a use no row allows and a count above its max; a row whose count has fallen is stale (a warning until the
# migration ends). Each change of the migration lowers or deletes the rows it makes stale. What stays for good is in the check itself.
